US DIESEL PRICES NEAR APRIL PEAK

US diesel prices climbed to $5.688 a gallon Tuesday, just below April’s peak, intensifying inflation concerns.

Wars in the Middle East and Ukraine are tightening global fuel supplies, while attacks on Russian refineries have reduced exports.
